cases.title: Clicking an available seat marks it as selected and updates count
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat (without the occupied class) marks it as selected and updates the selected seat count in the element with data-testid="selected-count".

cases.title: Occupied seats are not selectable and do not affect count or price
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as occupied cannot be selected and do not affect the selected seat count or total price.

cases.title: Selecting a movie updates total price based on selected seats and movie price
cases.description: Verify that selecting a movie from the dropdown with data-testid="movie-select" updates the total price in data-testid="total-price", calculated as the number of selected seats multiplied by the selected movie's price.

cases.title: Changing the selected movie updates the total price accordingly
cases.description: Verify that changing the selected movie at any time updates the total price based on the new movie price while maintaining the selected seat count.

cases.title: Select a movie from dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that users can select a movie from the dropdown menu (e.g., 'The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', and 'No Country for Old Men ($9)', each identified by a specific data-testid) and its price updates accordingly.

cases.title: Toggle seat selection status and store in localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat (e.g., identified by data-testid="seat-1-1") toggles the seat's selection status, visually marks it as selected, and stores its index in localStorage.

cases.title: Dynamic update of seat count and total price
cases.description: Verify that the seat count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price") are dynamically updated based on the number of selected seats and the chosen movie's price.

cases.title: Restrict selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected or included in the calculation.

cases.title: Deselect previously selected seats
cases.description: Verify that users can deselect previously selected seats by clicking on them again, and the UI, along with localStorage, updates accordingly.

cases.title: Restore selected seats and movie from localStorage
cases.description: Verify that upon page load, if localStorage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the corresponding seats are marked with the 'selected' class and the movie dropdown is set to the correct option.

cases.title: Default state when localStorage is empty
cases.description: Verify that if localStorage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the dropdown defaults to the first movie option, 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Set ticket price on movie selection
cases.description: Verify that when the user selects a movie from the dropdown menu with data-testid 'movie-select', the ticket price is set according to the selected movie's value.

cases.title: Toggle selected class and update count on seat click
cases.description: Verify that as the user clicks on available seats (those without the 'occupied' class), the system toggles the 'selected' class on the clicked seat and updates the count of selected seats displayed with data-testid 'selected-count'.

cases.title: Calculate total price based on selected count and ticket price
cases.description: Verify that the total price, displayed with data-testid 'total-price', is calculated as the product of the number of selected seats and the current ticket price.

cases.title: Decrease count and total price upon seat deselection
cases.description: Verify that if a user deselects a seat by clicking on it again, the count and total price decrease accordingly.

cases.title: Recalculate total price on movie change with existing seat selections
cases.description: Verify that if the user changes the movie selection after selecting seats, the total price updates based on the new ticket price while maintaining the count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that the system prevents users from selecting seats marked as 'occupied'.

cases.title: Distinguish Seat Statuses Through Legends
cases.description: Verify that the Movie Seat Booking page displays legends with corresponding data-testid (such as data-testid='seat-select') to help users distinguish between available, selected, and occupied seat statuses.

cases.title: Non-Interactive Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that occupied seats are clearly marked and non-interactive to prevent selection.

cases.title: Toggle Available Seat Selection
cases.description: Verify that available seats can be clicked to toggle their selection status.

cases.title: Update Count and Total Price on Seat Selection or Deselection
cases.description: Verify that when users select or deselect seats, the count of selected seats and the total price are updated accordingly.

opinions.feedback: All requirements are fully covered by the proposed test cases with no blockers or missing explicit scenarios.
All requirements and cases are fully aligned, clear, and cover all specified behaviors without redundant or unstated elements.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 contains multiple distinct behaviors: interacting with the seat map, updating the total price, marking available seats as selected upon click, updating selected seat count in data-testid="selected-count", selecting a movie from data-testid="movie-select", calculating total price based on selected seats and movie price, preventing occupied seats from being selectable, and updating total price when the selected movie changes. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 contains multiple distinct behaviors: selecting a movie from a dropdown with specific options and data-testid, updating price on movie selection, toggling seat selection status on click, visually marking selected seats, storing indices in localStorage, dynamically updating seat count and total price, restricting occupied seats, deselecting seats by clicking again, and updating the UI and localStorage accordingly. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 contains multiple distinct behaviors: retrieving and applying previously selected seats and movie selection from local storage on page load, marking seats based on 'selectedSeats', setting movie dropdown based on 'selectedMovieIndex', and handling missing localStorage keys by defaulting to no selected seats and the first movie option. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 contains multiple distinct behaviors: dynamically displaying selected seat count and total price, setting ticket price on movie selection, toggling 'selected' class on available seats, updating 'selected-count', calculating 'total-price' as product of selected count and ticket price, decreasing count and price upon deselection, recalculating total price on movie change while maintaining seat count, and preventing selection of occupied seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: distinguishing seat statuses through legends with data-testid, presenting non-interactive occupied seats, allowing clicks on available seats to toggle selection, and updating seat count and total price on seat selection or deselection.
